--a.help: server HTTP/HTTPS listen address, in form ":port", "ip:port", or for IPv6 "[ip]:port". If the IP is omitted, it defaults to all interfaces. Serves HTTPS if the port is 443 and/or -certmode is manual, otherwise HTTP.

--accept-connection-burst.help: burst limit for accepting new connection

--ace.help: whether to enable embedded ACE server [experimental + in-development as of 2025-09-12; not yet documented]

--acme-eab-key.help: ACME External Account Binding (EAB) HMAC key, base64-encoded (required for --certmode=gcp)

--acme-eab-kid.help: ACME External Account Binding (EAB) Key ID (required for --certmode=gcp)

--acme-email.help: ACME account contact email address (required for --certmode=gcp, optional for letsencrypt)

--acme-ip-certs.help: whether to serve LetsEncrypt certs for the server's IP addresses: when a client connects by IP address (sending no TLS SNI, or an IP address SNI matching the connection's destination IP), get and serve a LetsEncrypt cert for that IP, using the short-lived (~6 day) ACME certificate profile. This works for both IPv4 and IPv6 with no per-address configuration. It requires --certmode=letsencrypt and the ACME server must be able to reach port 80 at each such IP for the HTTP-01 challenge.

--add.help: a comma-separated list of features or tags to add, if --min is used.

--allow-hosts.help: Comma-separated list of allowed target hosts to additionally allow if --tailscale-only is true

--alpine.help: print the tag of alpine docker image

--api-key.help: The API key to query the Tailscale API with.\nSee https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys

--app.help: appliance name; one of the subdirectories of gokrazy/

--auth.help: auth with cigocached and exit, printing the access token as output

--backend-addr.help: Address of the Grafana server served over HTTP, in host:port format. Typically localhost:nnnn.

--bird-socket.help: path of the bird unix socket

--blend.help: blend reality (controlplane.tailscale.com and DERPs) into the virtual network

--bootstrap-dns-names.help: optional comma-separated list of hostnames to make available at /bootstrap-dns

--bucket.help: S3 bucket to upload disk image to while making AMI

--build.help: if true, just build locally and stop, without uploading

--bw-interval.help: bandwidth probe interval (0 = no bandwidth probing)

--bw-tun-ipv4-addr.help: if specified, bandwidth probes will be performed over a TUN device at this address in order to exercise TCP-in-TCP in similar fashion to TCP over Tailscale via DERP; we will use a /30 subnet including this IP address

--cachedir.help: if non-empty, use this directory to store cached size results to speed up subsequent runs. The tool does not consider the git status when deciding whether to use the cache. It's on you to nuke it between runs if the tree changed.

--certdir.help: directory to store ACME (e.g. LetsEncrypt) certs, if addr's port is :443

--certmode.help: mode for getting a cert. possible options: manual, letsencrypt, gcp

--cigocached-host.help: optional cigocached host to dial instead of the host in the provided --cigocached-url. Useful for public TLS certs on private addresses.

--cigocached-url.help: optional cigocached URL (scheme, host, and port). Empty means to not use one.

--cleanup.help: clean up system state and exit

--clone-only-type.help: comma-separated list of types (a subset of --type) that should only generate a go:generate clone line and not actual views

--config.help: path to config file, or 'vm:user-data' to use the VM's user-data (EC2); prefix with 'optional:' to boot unconfigured when the source is absent instead of failing

--configs.help: like --files, but for files marked as user-editable config files

--debug.help: listen address ([ip]:port) of optional debug server

--depends.help: comma-separated list of packages this package depends on

--derp.help: whether to run a DERP server. The only reason to set this false is if you're decommissioning a server but want to keep its bootstrap DNS functionality still running.

--derp-map.help: URL to DERP map (https:// or file://) or 'local' to use the local tailscaled's DERP map

--description.default: The easiest, most secure, cross platform way to use WireGuard + oauth2 + 2FA/SSO

--dev-control.help: URL of a development control server to be used with dev. If provided without specifying dev, an error will be returned.

--dgram.help: enable datagram mode; for use with macOS Hypervisor.Framework and VZFileHandleNetworkDeviceAttachment

--dir.help: tsnet state directory; a default one will be created if not provided

--distdir.help: path of directory to place build output in

--driver.help: address of the test driver; by default we use the DNS name test-driver.tailscale which is special cased in the emulated network's DNS server

--fast-compression.help: Use faster compression when building, to speed up build time. Meant to iterative/debugging use only.

--features.help: comma-separated list of features to list in the table, without the ts_omit_ prefix. It may also contain a '+' sign(s) for ANDing features together. If empty, all omittable features are considered one at a time.

--files.help: comma-separated list of files in src:dst form

--funnel.help: use Tailscale Funnel to make tsidp available on the public internet

--gaf.help: if true, build a gokrazy archive format file instead of a full disk image

--go.help: print the supported Go toolchain git hash (a github.com/tailscale/go commit)

--go-url.help: print the URL to the tarball of the Tailscale Go toolchain

--home.help: what to serve at the root path. It may be left empty (the default, for a default homepage), "blank" for a blank page, or a URL to redirect to

--host.help: target hostname or IP (SSH as root)

--hostname.help: TLS host name for certs, if addr's port is :443. It can be an IP address when --certmode=manual (to avoid SNI checks) or when --acme-ip-certs is set (to run an IP-only server with no hostname cert)

--http.help: address on which to start the debug http server

--http-port.help: The port on which to serve HTTP. Set to -1 to disable. The listener is bound to the same IP (if any) as specified in the -a flag.

--https.help: reverse proxy as HTTPS with an auto-issued Tailscale cert; implies --http

--https-dst-ports.help: comma-separated list of HTTPS destination ports to monitor

--instance.help: instance label value; defaults to hostname if unspecified

--json.help: emit one machine-readable JSON result line to stdout

--kb-path.help: filepath to the client-metrics knowledge base

--kb-url.help: URL to the client-metrics knowledge base page

--list.help: if true, list all known features and what they do

--logcollection.help: If non-empty, logtail collection to log to

--login-server.help: URL to alternative control server. If empty, the default Tailscale control is used.

--max.help: Maximum number of tags to sync (0 for all tags)

--mbps.help: Mbps (mebibit/s) per-client rate limit; 0 means unlimited

--mesh-psk-file.help: if non-empty, path to file containing the mesh pre-shared key file. It must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; whitespace is trimmed.

--mesh-with.help: optional comma-separated list of hostnames to mesh with; the server's own hostname can be in the list. If an entry contains a slash, the second part names a hostname to be used when dialing the target.

--min.help: remove all features not mentioned in --add

--mode.help: XDP mode; valid modes: [xdp, xdpgeneric, xdpdrv, xdpoffload]

--nat2.help: type of NAT to use for second network

--next.help: if set, modifies --go or --go-url to use the upcoming/unreleased/rc Go release version instead

--nfake.help: number of fake nodes to add to network

--no-logs-no-support.help: disable log uploads; this also disables any technical support

--once.help: probe once and print results, then exit; ignores the listen flag

--pcap.help: if non-empty, filename to write pcap

--pi.help: alias for --host, kept for backwards compatibility with the Makefile

--pkg-name.help: name of the package on the packages server, including the stable/unstable track prefix

--pkgdir.help: path of directory to place NPM package build output in

--qd-packet-timeout.help: queuing delay packets arriving after this period of time from being sent are treated like dropped packets and don't count toward queuing delay timings

--qd-packets-per-second.help: if greater than 0, queuing delay will be measured continuously using 260 byte packets (approximate size of a CallMeMaybe packet) sent at this rate per second

--rate-config.help: if non-empty, path to JSON rate limit config file. Rate limiting is experimental and subject to change. Configuration is reloaded on SIGHUP.

--recommends.help: comma-separated list of packages this package recommends

--region.help: AWS region for import+register; default us-east-1 (honors $AWS_REGION)

--region-code.help: probe only this region (e.g. 'lax' or '17'); if left blank, all regions will be probed

--remote-path.help: where on the appliance to stage the GAF before the update

--remove.help: a comma-separated list of features to remove from the build. (without the 'ts_omit_' prefix)

--replaces.help: package which this package replaces, if any

--rootdir.help: Root directory of repo. If not specified, will be inferred from the cwd.

--rotations.help: number of rotation signatures before re-signing (max 16)

--secrets-cache-dir.help: directory to cache setec secrets in (required if --secrets-url is set)

--secrets-url.help: SETEC server URL for secrets retrieval of mesh key

--show-removals.help: if true, show a table of sizes removing one feature at a time from the full set.

--socket.help: optional alternate path to tailscaled socket (only relevant when using --verify-clients)

--sockpath.help: the filesystem path for the unix socket this service exposes

--spread.help: whether to spread probing over time

--state-dir.help: Directory in which to store the Tailscale auth state

--statedir.help: path to directory for storage of config state, TLS certs, temporary incoming Taildrop files, etc. If empty, it's derived from --state when possible.

--stats.help: fetch and print cigocached stats and exit

--stun.help: whether to run a STUN server. It will bind to the same IP (if any) as the --addr flag value.

--stun-dst-ports.help: comma-separated list of STUN destination ports to monitor

--stun-port.help: The UDP port on which to serve STUN. The listener is bound to the same IP (if any) as specified in the -a flag.

--syslog.help: log to the system syslog daemon instead of stderr

--syspolicy-file.help: path to a JSON syspolicy file applied as a device-scope policy source; empty disables

--tailnet-name.help: The Tailnet name to lookup nodes within.\nSee https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/general

--tailscale-only.help: Restrict proxy to Tailscale targets only

--tcp-dst-ports.help: comma-separated list of TCP destination ports to monitor

--tcp-write-timeout.help: TCP write timeout; 0 results in no timeout being set on writes

--test-ip.help: if non-empty, look up IP and exit before running a server

--theme.help: color theme for Tailscale icon: dark, dark:nobg, light, light:nobg

--token.help: the cigocached access token to use, as created using --auth

--unpublished-bootstrap-dns-names.help: optional comma-separated list of hostnames to make available at /bootstrap-dns and not publish in the list. If an entry contains a slash, the second part names a DNS record to poll for its TXT record with a `0` to `100` value for rollout percentage.

--upstream-addr.help: Address of the upstream Postgres server, in host:port format

--upstream-ca-file.help: File containing the PEM-encoded CA certificate for the upstream server

--use-https.help: Serve over HTTPS via your *.ts.net subdomain if enabled in Tailscale admin.

--use-local-tailscaled.help: use local tailscaled instead of tsnet

--verify-client-url.help: if non-empty, an admission controller URL for permitting client connections; see tailcfg.DERPAdmitClientRequest

--verify-client-url-fail-open.help: whether we fail open if --verify-client-url is unreachable

--verify-clients.help: verify clients to this DERP server through a local tailscaled instance.

--wsproxy.help: if non-empty, TCP address to run websocket server on. See https://github.com/copy/v86/blob/master/docs/networking.md#backend-url-schemes

--yarnpath.help: path yarn executable used to install JavaScript dependencies
